FRIBgo2sea 2026

FRIB · Fcuking Ride It Bru · est. 2011 · It's a lifestyle. Built for the Old Mutual go2sea, 10–17 September 2026. Route data from the organisers' GPX files (downsampled, so climbing figures are conservative — the organisers quote ±11 000 m for the week); terrain from SRTM 30 m; drive times estimated with OSRM plus a gravel allowance. Start times, race-village venues and the Ballito finish point are assumptions until the rider briefing says otherwise. Historical facts checked against Wikipedia, SA History Online, Berg & Bush and SA-Venues. Jokes unverified.
